name: VoiceWukong
description: Benchmark for detecting synthetic/deepfake voices generated by many commercial and open-source voice synthesis and voice-conversion tools, with multiple manipulation variants intended to reflect real-world spoofing conditions.
evaluation_method: classification_metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, F1, and ROC-AUC for distinguishing bona fide from synthetic or manipulated speech
notes: Covers diverse language and manipulation settings; designed to expose robustness gaps in deepfake voice detectors. Exact item count is not specified in the provided metadata.
